title: Where saving company interrupts judgment
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 256
summary: The shabad begins with the fear of inescapable judgment. It directs the heart toward the saving nearness of Saadh Sangat and remembrance.
whyItMatters: This matters for anyone who feels cut off, exposed, or already condemned. The shabad changes the atmosphere from private doom to shared shelter.
takeaway: Holy company keeps judgment from having the final word.

lines.gurmukhi: ਢਾਹਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕਿਨਹਿ ਨ ਘਾਲਿਓ ਬੰਧ ॥
lines.transliteration: ddaahan laage dharam rai kineh na ghaalio ba(n)dh ||
lines.translation: When the Righteous Judge of Dharma begins to destroy someone, no one can place any obstacle in His Way.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਪਿ ਹਰੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸਨਬੰਧ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ubare jap haree saadhasa(n)g sanaba(n)dh ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who join the Saadh Sangat and meditate on the Lord are saved. ||1||

structure: The shabad begins by naming the helplessness of standing before judgment.
From there it turns toward the company where remembrance is still alive.
The closing movement rests by showing that salvation is received in Sangat, not manufactured alone.
